content.user_title: Build Programmatic SEO Pages at Scale
content.value_statement: Scaling SEO pages often creates thin content and weak site architecture. This skill guides keyword patterns, data strategy, templates, internal links, and launch checks for useful pages.
actual_capabilities: Identify repeatable keyword patterns for scalable SEO page sets.
Map page types to playbooks such as locations, comparisons, integrations, directories, and glossaries.
Define data requirements for unique, useful programmatic pages.
Draft page templates with titles, metadata, headings, content sections, and schema guidance.
Plan internal linking, sitemap, indexation, and crawl budget controls.
Create launch and monitoring checklists for quality and performance.
limitations: It does not verify live search volume or ranking data without user-provided research.
It does not generate or publish pages directly.
It cannot guarantee rankings or traffic growth.
It needs accurate data sources to avoid thin or duplicated content.

use_cases.title: Validate a Page-Scale Opportunity
use_cases.description: Assess whether a repeatable keyword pattern has enough demand, data, and quality potential before investing in pages.

use_cases.title: Plan Local or Directory Pages
use_cases.description: Design location, directory, or category pages with useful data, internal links, and indexation controls.

use_cases.title: Define Templates for Implementation
use_cases.description: Turn SEO strategy into page templates, data fields, content rules, and quality checks for a build team.

prompt_templates.title: Assess the Opportunity
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner discovery for a possible programmatic SEO project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether programmatic SEO fits my business. Product: [product]. Audience: [audience]. Target search patterns: [patterns]. Available data: [data]. Conversion goal: [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Playbook
prompt_templates.scenario: Select the best page type before planning templates.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the best programmatic SEO playbooks for this opportunity: [opportunity]. Recommend one primary playbook and explain data needs, quality risks, and page examples.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Page Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a reusable template for one page pattern.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a page template for [keyword pattern]. Include URL structure, title pattern, meta description, H1, sections, unique data fields, internal links, and schema guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the Launch System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for scale, quality, and monitoring.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased launch plan for [page type]. Include data sources, unique content rules, internal links, indexation rules, quality checks, and monitoring metrics.

output_examples.input: A marketplace wants city service pages for tax preparers.
output: Required unique data: local providers, prices, regulations, ratings, and city-specific FAQs.
Launch warning: do not index cities with missing provider data.

output_examples.input: A SaaS company wants pages for every product integration.
output: Template sections should cover setup, use cases, supported features, screenshots, and related tools.
Quality requirement: only publish pages for real or clearly planned integrations.

output_examples.input: A B2B site wants glossary pages for industry terms.
output: Each page should include a clear definition, examples, related terms, and internal links.
Monitoring focus: indexation rate, rankings by term cluster, engagement, and assisted conversions.

best_practices: Start with a small page set that has proven search demand and strong data.
Require unique data, examples, or insights on every generated page.
Monitor indexation, rankings, engagement, and conversions by page pattern.
anti_patterns: Do not create pages that only swap city, product, or keyword names.
Do not index pages with missing data or no clear search demand.
Do not hide poor rankings by generating more low-quality pages.

faq.question: What is programmatic SEO?
faq.answer: Programmatic SEO creates many useful pages from repeatable search patterns, templates, and structured data.

faq.question: Does this skill create the pages for me?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan strategy, templates, data requirements, linking, indexation, and quality checks.

faq.question: Can it help avoid thin content?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes unique data, useful page sections, quality controls, and selective indexing.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide keyword patterns, audience details, search research, available data sources, competitors, and business goals.

faq.question: Which page types does it support?
faq.answer: It covers templates, curation, conversions, comparisons, examples, locations, personas, integrations, glossaries, translations, directories, and profiles.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
